tesserae, tesserārum f. pl.

noun, first declension, plural

Neither book has these in the sections swept. In the lexicon tessera is also a ticket.

Examples

  • tesserīs lūdere

    play dicecomposed

  • Tesserās jace!

    Throw the dice!composed

See also knucklebones, game board, Passport / ticket / ticket agent / e-ticket.
